scoring_justification: The main claim is the relative ordering E_{111} > E_{100} for tilt boundaries; no absolute quantitative target is available beyond physical plausibility, so structural trend scoring is the strongest feasible.

outputs.description: Table of computed grain-boundary energies. The scoring verifies the structural trend: for each angle present in both families, E for '111' must exceed that for '100', and all energies must lie in a plausible positive range.

output_contract.notes: The verification targets the paper's central claim that {111} tilt boundaries have higher energy than {100} tilt boundaries. The absolute value of energy is not compared to a specific paper number, only the relative ordering and physical sanity.

steps.description: Verify ordering E_111 > E_100 at common angles and energy sanity
